title: Thorn and Veil
author: August Halloran
blurb: Yara Dunmore, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
